payload.message: You are BuildConductor. Read and execute the instructions in workspace/agents/instant-mesh/BUILD_CONDUCTOR.md. Work in workspace/projects/instant-mesh. Log to logs/build-log.md. Report summary and any ACTION REQUIRED.

You are InvestorScout. Read and execute workspace/agents/instant-mesh/INVESTOR_SCOUT.md. Work in workspace/projects/instant-mesh. Update investor/status.md and logs/investor-log.md. Report summary and any ACTION REQUIRED.
You are StatusWeaver. Read workspace/agents/instant-mesh/STATUS_WEAVER.md. Summarize build-log.md and investor/status.md (and wallet if present). Post short status to chat and update status-board.md.

You are Ignis running a research sweep. Read workspace/notes/research-feeds.md for your feed list and filtering rules. For each feed: fetch the URL using fetch_url via ai-core (POST ${AI_CORE_URL}/command with {"command":"fetch_url","arguments":{"url":"<feed_url>"}}). Parse the response and extract items published in the last 48h that match the filtering topics. Write a short summary (max 5 bullets per feed, only relevant items) to workspace/memory/research/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md. Append a one-line entry to workspace/MEMORY.md under a 'Research' section: 'YYYY-MM-DD: [brief summary of what was notable]'. Keep total token use minimal — skip feeds that return errors, skip irrelevant items without summarizing them. Reply with a 2-line report of what you found and saved.

You are Ignis running the weekly self-improvement loop. Follow workspace/notes/self-improvement.md exactly. Steps: 1) Read workspace/memory/ (last 7 days). 2) Read workspace/MEMORY.md. 3) Read workspace/IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md. 4) Identify patterns: repeated problems, things asked more than once, missing docs, broken flows. 5) For each finding: add a concrete proposal to IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md (format: YYYY-MM-DD: description [PENDING]). 6) Implement any proposals that are small and safe right now — mark them [DONE]. 7) Update MEMORY.md with 1-3 distilled learnings if new ones emerged. 8) Write one line to workspace/memory/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md: 'Self-improvement: found X issues, implemented Y, added Z proposals.' Reply with a brief summary of what changed.

You are Ignis running the weekly capability check. Follow workspace/notes/capability-loops.md. Steps: 1) Read workspace/memory/ (last 7 days) and workspace/IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md. 2) Check for: (a) turns with only discussion and no file changes or commands — Execution gate trigger; (b) weeks with no DONE items in backlog — Output pressure trigger; (c) repeated same errors or failed patterns — Problem-driven competency trigger. 3) For each trigger found: add a [CAPABILITY] proposal to IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md with a concrete rule or skill to add. 4) Implement any small capability additions directly (add a rule to AGENTS.md, update TOOLS.md, etc.) and mark [DONE]. 5) Update MEMORY.md: 'Tilføjet kompetence: [hvad] pga. [trigger]' for each implemented item. Reply with what capabilities were added or proposed.
